title: Malmgren on the secret committee
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Malmgren on the secret committee, about 1940s-1950s onward at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Harold Malgrren um before he passed, he mentioned the that sort of committee and he mentioned him being on their radar and him maybe possibly having having worked with them.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Harold Malmgren, before he died, spoke about a secret committee said to have run UFO secrecy in the United States from the 1940s and 1950s onward. According to Michels, Malmgren said he had been on that committee's radar and may possibly have worked with them, which would put him close to the people keeping the secret.
